text.en:
The name of the present road traversing Sto. Tomas, Batangas City, and Nasugbu, now called
the Sto. Tomas-Batangas City-Nasugbu Road, is hereby changed to "PRESIDENT LAUREL HIGHWAY."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
